prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, refinement of an existing certificate album concept.
Create ONE refined production-quality desktop web UI design showing a real BOOK-LIKE, PAGE-TURNING keepsake album. Target viewport 1440 x 1024, current date 2026-10-09 Asia/Shanghai. Full flat web page with no browser chrome, device bezel or collage. This is a revision of the attached first reference, which is too much like a card carousel. Replace the carousel and thumbnail strip with a beautiful physical open book metaphor.

Reference roles:
Image 1 is the previous interface: preserve the warm ivory brand palette, rounded friendly dark brown Chinese typography, calm whitespace and existing website header character.
Image 2 is the APPROVED Lesson 1–2 full certificate: preserve all its card art, identities, blue title 礼貌小帮手, warm paper, full slim gold edge, five golden stars, sample name 小雨 and Lesson 1–2 footer.
Image 3 is the APPROVED Lesson 3–4 full certificate: preserve all its card art, identities, purple title 认领小达人, warm paper, full slim gold edge, five golden stars, sample name 小雨 and Lesson 3–4 footer.
Image 4 is the exact existing yellow star-flower with green leaves brand logo, use it modestly at header left.
Use only the certificate itself from images 2 and 3, not their background screens or external buttons.

Composition:
Warm ivory page. Slim header with brand logo + exact "灿然英语工作室" left, simple navigation "我的课程" and active "我的纪念册" toward right, sample account label "小雨" far right. No avatar, dropdown, slogans or other navigation.
Above the book, modest heading "小雨的纪念册" on the left, a small genuine brown-outline button "目录" on the right.
The hero is one OPEN LANDSCAPE HARDBACK ALBUM occupying about 1180px width x 525px height, centered with generous margins. Near-orthographic overhead/front view, almost flat and perfectly readable, no dramatic perspective. Two facing broad paper pages, each around 550x480 with a rounded outer edge. A clearly visible central stitched/bound gutter/spine crease, gentle graduated fold shadow, a few subtly layered cream page edges at bottom, and a thin muted sage cloth cover projecting beyond the pages. These details must make it unmistakably a book, not two UI cards side-by-side. Fine warm brown outlines and soft paper texture consistent with the course art. The binding is restrained and tactile, not luxury leather, metallic ornament, wire spiral, scrapbook tape, wood shelves or photoreal desk props.

Place ONE COMPLETE certificate mounted neatly on EACH book page with fine paper corner mounts:
LEFT PAGE: Lesson 1–2 handbag close-up certificate.
RIGHT PAGE: Lesson 3–4 umbrella counter close-up certificate.
Certificates remain horizontal at their approved approximately 1.86:1 card ratio, about 480x258 px each. Never split one certificate across the central spine; no fold through a face, name or star. Preserve complete gold rim and all five star positions on each card, exact titles, student name and course labels. Footer dates for this sample: Lesson 1–2 · 2026.10.07 and Lesson 3–4 · 2026.10.08. Exactly five stars each, no decorative stars elsewhere except the brand logo. Text is crisp, pleasantly readable at this scale.
Below EACH mounted certificate, within its paper page, a small tactile outlined button with magnifying glass icon and exact label "放大查看". Put a tiny physical page number 1 and 2 at each outer lower corner. No duplicate slogans, stories, extra labels, paragraphs or progress metrics. A small gentle curl of the bottom-right paper corner can hint that this paper turns; curl only the blank page margin, never cover or warp the certificate artwork. The spine and page edges convey high-quality hand-crafted paper rather than a glossy 3D toy.

Below the book, a compact centered control row: muted disabled-looking left button with left arrow and exact "上一页", quiet page counter "1–2 / 3", green primary button with right arrow and exact "下一页". First spread is showing two of three collected cards; the third Lesson 5–6 card exists on the next page but must NOT appear in a thumbnail strip or float on this screen.
Keep all page edges and both navigation buttons fully inside the viewport. No large save button here because it would be unclear which of the two cards to save; saving belongs to each card's enlarged view.
Output just this focused open-book screen. No option numbers, explanatory annotations, mobile inset, animation arrows painted over the art, gigantic empty filler spaces or additional design concepts.
validation: Visual review only, no runtime or mobile behavior validation
